provenance_summary: V1-B biological expansion wave. Keratin from bird feather agricultural waste as bio-adsorbent for heavy metals and dyes. Rich in cysteine disulfide bonds and amino acid functional groups.

mechanisms.description: Keratin cysteine coordination: cysteine-rich keratin provides thiol (-SH) groups for heavy metal coordination, especially for soft metals like Hg²⁺, Ag⁺, Pb²⁺

pollutant_feature.text: Heavy metal ions (Hg²⁺, Ag⁺, Pb²⁺, Cu²⁺)

bio_structure.text: Cysteine thiol groups, amino groups, carboxyl groups

interaction.text: Coordination with thiol (-SH) and amino (-NH₂) groups on keratin

why_it_works.text: High affinity for soft heavy metals due to thiol groups

causal_chain.transferable_principle: Keratin cysteine thiol groups provide high-affinity binding for soft heavy metals

engineering_constraints.description: Keratin extraction: alkaline hydrolysis, enzymatic extraction, or steam explosion from feather waste

narrative.text: Bird feather keratin is an abundant agricultural waste product rich in cysteine (14% by weight). The thiol groups provide high affinity for soft heavy metals. Keratin-based adsorbents are biodegradable and low-cost.

design_translation.idea: Extract keratin from bird feather waste and use as bio-adsorbent for heavy metals, especially soft metals with high thiol affinity
examples: Chicken feather keratin for Hg²⁺ removal
Keratin nanofiber membrane for heavy metal filtration
design_translation.applicability: Heavy metal removal from wastewater; sustainable waste valorization

knowledge_gaps: Need primary research papers with quantitative performance data
